newsitem.title: USA: DTM IPO cuts price range - underwriter.
newsitem.headline: DTM IPO cuts price range - underwriter.

text.p: The estimated price range for the planned initial public offering in DTM Corp was lowered to a target price of $8 from a range of $9 to $11, lead underwriter A.G. Edwards said on Thursday.

The initial public offering, expected to trade on Friday, will retain the proposed number of shares on offer at 3.039 million shares as originally planned. The company is expected to trade under the symbol "DTMC" on the Nasdaq National Market.
DTM Corp deals in rapid prototyping and rapid tooling systems.
